Results.ReviewText: I've used Weber Kettles for a long time and just upgraded to the Premium last fall. The ash catcher system was the deciding factor for me. It makes cleanup and temp control a breeze.
Results.Title: The only grill you'll ever need

Results.ReviewText: This was a replacement grill for our first Weber which lasted almost 30 years. I don’t expect to out live this grill but it sure does look good. I expect this grill to perform the same way the old one did, and hopefully it will.
Results.Title: Replacement grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! Your feedback regarding the lid thermometer is very important to us. We will be sure to pass this along to our team for consideration. Please be on the look out for an outreach email from us to discuss further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It's good overall, but, as I learn to use it, something dawned on me.  The top vent and the temperature should have been on the same side.  Having the vent and temperature on opposite sides makes no sense.
Results.Title: Decent Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the Original Kettle Premium. We are so sorry to learn of your disappointment with the quality of the grill. We are passing along your feedback to our team for consideration. Our Support team will be reaching out via email to see how we can assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The cheap aluminum tabs on the bottom tray don't fit the slots and causes a weak assembly trying to tap them in. You went too far with the cheapness efforts. Overall build quality was not as good as I'd hoped for a 250 dollar spend. Those joints need thicker metal and some machine screws at a minimum. This base will be falling apart before the full life is reached.
Results.Title: Weak aluminum tabs, fit is not good in these areas

Results.ReviewText: Always works great. Have had Weber's for over thirty years
Results.Title: Great old or new

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes the ONLY charcoal grill worth owning.  I have wornnout one of these and bought 4 more for myself and children over the course of 30 years.  My first lasted me 20 years and I bough a 26 and a 22 to replace it when the family got larger.  I buy them for my Daughters when they buy new homes !!
Results.Title: Bestest Grills Known to MAN and Girls

Results.ReviewText:
This decades old design is still a winner.  It does a great job of barbecuing.  And it can be used to cook a wide variety of foods many different ways.
Assembly should be easier.
Results.Title: Works great.  Assembly could be easier.

Results.ReviewText: Stable temperature control - easy to clean - it’s a great grill

Results.ReviewText: The ash cleaning mechanism and the air inlet handle are fantastic.
Results.Title: Ash removal

Results.ReviewText: i bought this one with the rotisserie, perfection for chicken
Results.Title: 22" with rotisserie

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. I own two other Weber grills and I expect this one will last as long as the other two have. High quality
Results.Title: High quality grill

Results.ReviewText: Great quality and size. This can be used for grilling or smoking foods!
Results.Title: Excellent Product

Results.ReviewText: Good product from grilling  Pattie’s to make a desert Smokey one
Results.Title: Is the best way to start in the grillin word enjoy

Results.ReviewText: This grill is great. Typical great quality I expected from Weber. Great for grilling and smoking. I expect to get years and years of use of this grill.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love  this grill, the catch tray is a very welcome addition. I could never use my old grill on my wood deck, now I can. It is easy to adjust the temp with the vents. Great quality, and customer service is awesome.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: Not having a hinged lid is a little awkward for me- kind of got used to that with my gas grille. Overall, a nice unit, gets the job done.  The ash disposal feature is very helpful
Results.Title: Nice Grille

Results.ReviewText: Hard to say exactly what I like the most. Weber has really come along way with these grills I am using at least three nights a week and have completely fell back in love with FIRE!
Results.Title: Being happy with my pirchase

Results.ReviewText: I think the Weber Kettle is the most versatile charcoal grill made. I've cooked almost every meat and vegetable on it and have always gotten rave reviews. It works great as a smoker as well - everything from fish to turkeys. I replaced a standard 22" grill with the Premium and love it.
Results.Title: The Best Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, as expected. I’m new to charcoal and getting away from the gas grill world. The biggest difference has been adding a little more time for charcoal prep and grill pre-heating. But that isn’t a problem. Still playing with how much charcoal is needed and how long the coals will provide ample heat. That will continue to improve with time and experience. No regrets on making this move!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I've had the 22" Kettle Grill for about a month now. I've cooked a chicken half, pork ribs, pork belly and beef Dino ribs and all came out great. I bought the Weber Char-basket charcoal holder and they are ok for the price but will be buying the Slow 'N Sear Deluxe soon for a permanent solution because Weber's are too cheap. I'm also very interested in getting a rotisserie for it. I highly recommend getting a bluetooth thermometer like the ThermoPro TP20, which Academy had for clearance $35 instead of the normal $60. The thermometer on the grill is ok but it won't give you the temp where your food is. Lastly for a $200 kettle is seems kind of cheap to not have high temp plastic on the lids smoke controller. Overall get this for a great grill with tons of aftermarket accessories like a Harley Davidson.
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: I was sceptical at first going from gas grilling to a Weber charcoal grilling. After a few times grillng and adjusting the amount of charcoal needed for each grill, to control heating and time for grilling, Also using different charcoal produces differnt flavor and taste to grilling. I love it! Looking forward to upscaling my outside kitchen to Charcoal grill with all Weber products.
Results.Title: Once a Weber, never going back!

Results.ReviewText: I received this grill as a Christmas gift. So far, I have done a roast and ribs on it. Unfortunately,  we  have three foot drifts of snow, and sub zero temperatures. I'll be using it again in March.
Results.Title: Lovin' it

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill! Love it so far! It cooks quickly and works well!
Results.Title: Great Grill!

We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with our team regarding the Original Kettle premium. Results.ReviewText: Three things stick out to me more than anything, the legs on it are very cheap built. The vent on the top should have some sort of rubber safe for touch knob, instead of the one on it. And it should come with accessories when you buy it. A chimney, and maybe the baskets. Holds heat well, and clean up on it is easy with the basket below. Overall it’s nice just wish there was a few things different on it.
Results.Title: Good all around grill.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve enjoyed my grill so far. I give 4 stars instead of 5 because the ash catcher assembly. The aluminum ring needs to be more durable. Upon assembly the rivet welds broke and the ring was useless after that. The Weber customer service team was nice to send me a replacement. I look forward to using this grill a lot.
Results.Title: Ash Catcher Assembly

Results.ReviewText: I got into grilling 2 years ago and I finally upgraded to a weber and no disappointment.
Results.Title: The best

Results.ReviewText: Assembly of this grill was VERY easy and straightforward. It’s very lightweight compared to other grills that I’ve owned, and I love the design and features of the grill and grates inside. It’s obvious that a lot of thought went into the design and manufacture of this Kettle Charcoal Grill.
Results.Title: Webber Kettle Charcoal Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the Original Premium kettle. We are so sorry to learn of your disappointment with the ash catcher. We would like to hear more of your thoughts on this. Our team has reached out via email to discuss this further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Y our new ash collection device is junk but probably saved you a dollar.  The old one was good  Only reason I have 2 of them the PK grill was sold out.  I have had Webbers my entire life.  These will end up on junk pile eart
Results.Title: New grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: J'ai reçu mon Weber 22 pouces à Noël. J'ai commencé à faire des cuissons le lendemain. Mes filles n'aiment pas vraiment la viande. J'ai fait du poulet et du porc, elles ont adorées. Juste pour ça, je suis très heureux de mon cadeau.
Results.Title: Pur bonheur!!

Results.ReviewText: Best by far, grew up with Pips using them and when we saw this original copper, we had to upgrade…now it’s time to eat…!
Results.Title: Can’t beat classic

Results.ReviewText: This has been my favorite grill for many years. Well built, great design, good size for everyday cooking, lots of accessories available, very easy to control temperature, overall the best grill I have used.
Results.Title: THE charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill for my husband for Christmas as a replacement to the one he’s had for about 9 years.  He’s used it twice and he’s in love again! He forgot how awesome it was to cook on a new grill.  Boston butt and chicken quarters have been perfect! Tonight hamburgers!
Results.Title: Weber 22” Kettle charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I was a fan of gas grills but  this one is 100 times better,the food tastes amazing! Now is the only one I use!
Results.Title: Best ever

Results.ReviewText: Only has one handle so you have to drag it around. Although brand new, the moving parts all creak and take hammering to move. Lid seems warped and does rest easily on top
Results.Title: Don’t make ‘em like they used to

Results.ReviewText: Like the Premium but noticed it burns less hotter than the regular grill
Results.Title: Premium

Results.ReviewText: Simple and convenient to use, well made, and the recipes on the Weber website are outstanding.
Results.Title: Well made

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback regarding the Original Kettle Premium. We are so sorry to learn about the issue with the leg and the triangle not fitting. This is not the quality we come to expect from our products. Our team has reached out via email to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Love the color.  I have been a Weber grill person my whole life.As far as assembly went,  not good. One of the legs wouldn't snap in. I had to grind the leg down 1/8 of an inch to get it to snap in. Then the triangle piece the the aluminum cross bar goes on wouldn't slide on and i had to drill that hole bigger. Good luck putting on the wheel caps . You need to flip it on its side so that you are pounding onto something solid. In my opinion the thermometer is in the wrong spot. When you turn the lid to cook indirectly so the vent is over the food. That puts the thermometer over rhe coals. Makes it kinda pointless.  I wish it had a second handle on the kettle.  Sometimes you cannot use one handle to roll it. I wish i could pick it up and carry it. So far the rest works as expected.
Results.Title: Not what I expect from Weber

Results.ReviewText: Awesome purchase. Customer service was great. I was missing the screws that hold the handle to the lid. Emailed Customer Service & got an entire replacement handle in 2 days. Webber lives up to its stellar reputation again.
Results.Title: Great Customer Service

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with our team regarding the Original Kettle premium. We take your feedback very seriously. Our team will be sure to pass this along. One of our team members has also reached out via email to discuss this further with you. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
Feedback on the grill. 
There is a design improvement that could be make. When user wants to move the grill, it can very easily tilt if the grill is lifted more than a few inches.
If back wheels would be a few inches away from the center of gravity this could be avoided. This is a safety concern as if the grill is on, user could get injured

Feedback on the cover
Good cover however when placed in a windy area, the cover goes off very quicly as there is only one tiny strap to attach it to the grill. 
Very poor design for the price
Results.Title: Good grill but…

Results.ReviewText: The charcoal grill works well. I am trying to set it up for smoking and for use with a digital thermometer.
Results.Title: Works well, still on a learning curve

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love it. We use the grill 3-4 times a week. The family could not be happier.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Well we had a tornado a few days after I purchase it so really didn’t get a chance to use it
Results.Title: 22 inch kettle

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
